description: Header file defining the DecryptingRenderer class, a wrapper around a media Renderer that handles stream decryption when an AesDecryptor is available. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and member variables related to media stream decryption.

classes.name: DecryptingRenderer
classes.description: A media Renderer wrapper that decrypts streams when an AesDecryptor is available, passing only clear streams to the internal renderer.

methods.name: DecryptingRenderer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the DecryptingRenderer with a renderer, media log, and task runner.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the renderer with a media resource, client, and callback.

methods.name: SetCdm
methods.description: Sets the Content Decryption Module context.

methods.name: SetLatencyHint
methods.description: Sets the latency hint for the renderer.

methods.name: SetPreservesPitch
methods.description: Configures whether the renderer preserves pitch during playback.

methods.name: SetWasPlayedWithUserActivation
methods.description: Indicates if the media was played with user activation.

methods.name: StartPlayingFrom
methods.description: Starts playback from a specified time.

methods.name: OnSelectedVideoTracksChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in selected video tracks.

methods.name: OnEnabledAudioTracksChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in enabled audio tracks.

methods.name: HasDecryptingMediaResourceForTesting
methods.description: Checks if a decrypting media resource exists (for testing).
